## Learning goals

By the end of this page:

- I will be able to make a clear nameplate layout.
- I will be able to rebuild a rough sketch as clean, editable vector artwork.
- I will be able to combine the logo and name and export useful files.

This is important because the fastest way to learn a design tool is to make something and revise it.

## Choose a tool

| Tool | Best reason to use it |
|---|---|
| [Photopea](https://www.photopea.com/) | Runs in a browser and is the class default. |
| [GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/) | Free desktop image editor. |
| [Adobe Photoshop](https://www.adobe.com/products/photoshop.html) | Industry-standard commercial image editor. |

Use Photopea unless your teacher approves another tool. Keep the editable source file and export a PNG or JPG for use.

## Start here

Start with the [Two-Class Photopea Practice Assignment](01-photopea-practice-assignment.qmd). It tells you exactly what to make and submit.

The assignment links these three worked guides when you need them:

1. [Guide 1: Build the Nameplate Text](01-nameplate-text-photopea.qmd)
2. [Guide 2: Trace the AA Logo](rough-sketch-to-svg-photopea.qmd)
3. [Guide 3: Trace a Multi-Layer Logo](02b-advanced-multilayer-tracing-photopea.qmd)

After the two-class practice:

4. [Combine the Logo and Nameplate](03-combine-logo-nameplate.qmd): follow the worked ANDRADE example and export the complete design.
5. [Design Your Own Name + Logo Name Tag](../03-laser-cutting/01-name-logo.qmd): use the practice skills to make and defend an original design.

Use [Accessible Design](../accessible-design/index.qmd) to compare font examples, zoom out to test readability, check contrast, and add useful alt text.

## Make something

- [Gaming / Roblox character logo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mchoizRTY-s)
- [Apex Legends thumbnail](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9V6Wp_OnQk)
- [Make a YouTube logo in under five minutes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmB14oyGWcw)
- [Photopea beginner crash course](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6dwSRbkSuq8)

Pick one video, make your own version, then change the wording, colours, images, spacing, and layout so the result fits your purpose.
